disclosure: We would like to check how well your confidence matches your accuracy. If you join, we will send you at most two short questions a month, on their own and never inside a panel question. Each is about something ACAPS already has a record of, and we ask how sure you are on a scale from 50 to 100 %. After 20 questions we write you one paragraph in plain words -- for example, 'when you said 90 % you were right about 7 times in 10'. You see it before anyone at ACAPS does, and the committee sees it only if you then say yes a second time. It is never used as a weight on your answers, never shown to other experts, and never a reason to approve or remove anyone. Reply STOP to this message at any time and we stop computing it.
confidence_prompt: How sure are you that this is right, 50 to 100 %?
never: Never without consent. Never a weight. Never to the committee before the expert. Never a reason to approve or remove anyone.
not_built: Fictitious references, response-time and edit-count measures and test-retest traps are deliberately not built: a participant would recognise any of them as deception if we explained it afterwards.
